nom: medicube PDRN Pink Niacinamide Milky Toner

avis.titre: Good but not amazing for a milky toner
avis.texte: This product evened my skin and was good for short term hydration but didn't hydrate as much as my other toners. I live in a hunid area and still dried out eith this one, even with facial oils and heavier moisturizers.
This toner works okay when used by itself but it is terrible when layering in a serum and moisturizer. Do not use Vitamin C serum on top or will cause flakiness.

This is my first bottle of the PDRN Milky Toner and I will be buying it again. It leaves my skin soft, plump and very hydrated. My skin is dry and I live in very hot climate so I apply two layers. It only takes a few drops per layer to cover your face
I have sensitive skin along with eczema and this product immediately caused my face to have red itchy bumps and overall irritated my skin.
I'm obsessed! After just two weeks, my skin looks so much more glow

avis.titre: I will continue to purchase this.
avis.texte: This has left my face feeling and looking amazing. So easy to use, allowing you to stay on routine. I will for sure be purchasing thing again

avis.titre: Saves my dry skin during winter
avis.texte: This revived my face. My face gets like Sahara desert dry fr.. this was like magic. I also have sensitive skin if that helps anyone.
It has a heavier texture than normal toner. Also I felt that it gave me redness after applying since my face has been looking redish for a while and was never like this before.

I like this toner. This is a oil-control toner, its lays a thick on skin. I like this for night time use & prep skin for product. Thick milky texture, a lil sticky consistency. Pairs well with my current routine and like the way it feels on my skin.

avis.titre: do NOT recommend - caused horrible acne
avis.texte: bought this less than a week ago, used it 4 times and I currently have the WORST acne I've had in years. I changed nothing else in my skincare except adding this and planning to immediately get rid of this product. Deep, inflamed cystic acne around my chin and neck line - something I have not had in over 5 years. The formulation is great, it feels nice and absorbs quickly, but the results are not there at all. I've seen several reviews saying the same thing, wish I had researched more before purchasing.

I have mature (more like ancient) dry skin. This toner absorbs instantly and is very hydrating. It doesn't make my face feel sticky like the serum does. I've even used it under my body lotion after a shower when the rest of my body felt dry & itchy.

I use this product and so does my teenage son. I had dry, dull and redness for skin issues. My son has acne and very sensitive skin. This product worked great for both of skin concerns. I highly recommend it! We use it in the morning and at night daily.
I have been using this product for over two months have don't have anymore breakouts during pms. I use this morning and night. So happy with the results.

i really like this toner! its a nice unique texture and color, and it is really moisturizing. i have pretty dry skin so i appreciate that the moisture penetrates my skin deeply. it has also helped clear up some newer breakouts, only been using it for about a week. very excited for continued use!
This product really works. It keeps your skin very hydrated. I'm very pleased that I was recommended this by one of Ulta's employees.

I love the way this feels and smells, HOWEVER, it pills every time I use it. No matter what other products I use, what order, even if I use it by itself on other parts of my body with nothing else, it still pills.

Tried product in September, skin started breaking out end of September. I thought it was just purging but completely damaged my skin barrier. 4 months later my skin is the worst its ever been, i now have perioral dermatitis all over my face. My skin was so clear before this product please please please beware

I've been using PRDN milky toner for a few weeks now, and I'm pleased with the results. Medicube as a whole, has been wonderful addition to my skincare routine. What I love, is how gentle it is on my sensitive skin. As well as, the silky smooth look and even skin tone it leaves behind. I'd reccomend using this after your normal cleanser, although they have a wonderful PRDN cleansar too!
Loved this product when applying. But this made me breakout so bad. Pimples all over for the full month i used it. Went away right as i stopped using it

I took a chance on this toner becuase I've seen revoews and each of them were ads, but this toner is truly great!! be careful though because some people say it broke them put but it has never broke me out and has helped my skin barrier so much!

I do noticed korean skin care brands dont suit my face most of the time. Unfortunately, including this one. Tried this one for 2 weeks because of the brand's hype, but i constantly have acne after using it. So, I'll return this item. Plus point of this one is, texture is light and quickly absorbed.

I've been using this toner for about a week, and I'm already seeing impressive results. I'm someone who struggles with cystic acne, and since starting this toner I haven't had any new breakouts at all. It has noticeably calmed my redness and has already started fading my acne scars, which I honestly didn't expect to happen so quickly. My skin looks smoother overall, and my makeup applies so much better and more evenly now. Even in such a short amount of time, this toner has made a visible difference in my skin. It's quickly becoming a staple in my routine, especially for anyone dealing with cystic acne, redness, or post-acne marks.
Not recommended for acne-prone skin. Blotchy redness all over my face, textured, & cystic break outs. My skin was so clear before using this < /3
This is great for hydration after cleansing and is a staple in my skin regimen.

avis.titre: Sets the foundation for moisture retention
avis.texte: If you have dry skin, this product helps. I live in a dry climate and this toner sets the foundation for the rest of the line that has truly transformed my skin.
This is the first toner I've ever used that did not dry me out!
This toner is the smoothest and silkiest toner that you can get. Love it!

It's not an overly hydrating feeling. Not really dewey. It's a thick creamy toner which I like. It does the job. Pricey compared to other toners on the market that are better. If you want to buy the brand, buy it. Otherwise, save your money.

Glowy and hydrating. Nevertheless, it caused me to have inflammated underneath pimples that were impossible to take out, none of the pimple patches would help. + to mention, I do not break out easily and was so suprised that it happened…

avis.titre: Love the feel of this toner.
avis.texte: Love this toner. It gave a nice glow and plumpness to my skin. Am definitely going to buy again.
